facts.fact: POTRAZ serves as Zimbabwe's Data Protection Authority under the Act and has issued Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026, per CITE.

SI 155 of 2024 requires organisations processing personal data of 50 or more individuals to hold a POTRAZ data controller licence, with fees from US$50 to US$2,500 a year; the requirement took effect in September 2024 with a compliance deadline of 12 March 2025, per CITE.

POTRAZ published Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026 announcing mandatory compliance inspections of data controllers from 1 September 2026; CITE says many organisations are believed not yet registered, and reports no sanction.
